meta.name: Grozăvești & Politehnica
meta.osm: OpenStreetMap API 0.6 /map tiles fetched 2026-11-06 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Every object keyed by OSM id (w=way, n=node, r=relation).

conventions.side: compass side of the street axis the object is on (N/NE/…)
conventions.lanes: OSM semantics: lanes = total, lanes_forward along way direction (dir = compass of first→last node)
conventions.style_est: heuristic from OSM tags (year/levels/type); research.* overrides
conventions.storeys_est: only when OSM has no levels/height: median of tagged same-type neighbours <90 m, else type default (see storeys_est_src)
conventions.facade_hex_est: district palette pick by style/type — an estimate, not an observation
conventions.colours: hex sRGB; *_est = estimated from district style rule, research.facade_hex = observed/sourced

sources.osm: https://www.openstreetmap.org (API 0.6 map tiles, 2026-11-06; tags lanes, turn:lanes, maxspeed, trolley_wire, building:*)

reality_pass_2026_11_08.scope: Current cities.js playable band/circles plus600m Euclidean scenery ring; historical boundary below is retained as provenance, not the new coverage claim.
reality_pass_2026_11_08.acceptance: In progress. Source coverage and review coverage do not imply complete world parity.
reality_pass_2026_11_08.roofManualReview: 80 calibrated crops plus all seven confident aerial/runtime discrepancies; explicit multi-wing pitched plans recorded, mixed roofs retained uncertain.

boundary.rationale: Extraction area = world agent bbox from cities.js BUC_DISTRICTS (so every street the world builds is covered). 1.39 km N-S × 1.35 km E-W ≈ 1.2 km² (some of it campus/park): north edge Bd. Regiei/Regie campus, east edge just past Podul Grozăvești/Șos. Grozăvești (Basarab overpass ramps), south edge Bd. Iuliu Maniu, west edge Str. Petre Popovăț/Splai bend; includes the whole UPB campus, Regie dorms, Grozăvești metro and the Dâmbovița with both Splai carriageways.

chapters.title: Politehnica (UPB) — Rectorat

end.desc: UPB Rectorat forecourt (campus road behind the Doina Cornea gate)

waypoints.desc: Bd. Doina Cornea southbound along the UPB campus
UPB Rectorat forecourt (campus road behind the Doina Cornea gate)

chapters.why: Come down Șos. Orhideelor (Basarab overpass towering alongside), cross the Dâmbovița on Podul Grozăvești (Grozăvești metro + Regie student campus on the right), turn onto Bd. Doina Cornea south along the UPB campus (tram reservation in the middle), then in through the campus gate to the Rectorat forecourt.

stops.name: Universitatea Politehnica din București — Rectorat
stops.address: Splaiul Independenței 313, Sector 6 (campus "Noul Local"; the Leu site is at Bd. Iuliu Maniu 1-3)
stops.building_osm: w28240552 (Rectorat, 5 levels) inside campus area w23608402

door.street: campus road (service, access=private, barrier at the gates)
door.gates: vehicle gates: Bd. Doina Cornea side (gate node n6810324892 at 44.43807, 26.05543) and Splaiul Independenței side (campus road w26314495/w178160268 meets the eastbound Splai at ≈44.4441, 26.0538)

building.facade: iconic 1970s modernist Rectorat: long symmetrical white concrete frame grid (#EDEDE8) with RED infill panels (#B8312F) between the window bays, recessed ground floor, and a wide shallow saucer-shaped DOME on the roof (aula), flagpoles; at night the dome rim is lit blue; large paved forecourt + parking

stops.cities_js_check: cities.js upb {44.4366, 26.0526} is ~200 m south of the Rectorat (near the Iuliu Maniu side of campus). The Rectorat is at {44.4385, 26.0515}; it has NO public-street frontage — the drive ends via a campus gate (Doina Cornea) and ~420 m of private campus road. The Splai carriageway next to the campus (way 227053932) is ONE-WAY EASTBOUND.

research.barrier_note: OSM maps NO jersey barrier/guard-rail across Orhideelor here; the concrete parapets belong to the elevated Pasajul Basarab ribbons above/alongside (bridge=yes, layer 1–2). The owner's "concrete barrier across the lane on Orhideelor" is therefore a generation bug (an overpass wall projected onto ground level) — walls must stay on the Basarab layer.

research.cross_section: the Dâmbovița runs in a straight concrete-lined canal (trapezoidal, ~40 m wide, low water, steel railings) with a ONE-WAY carriageway on each bank: south bank (campus side) EASTBOUND 2–3 lanes (40–50 km/h), north bank (Regie side) WESTBOUND 2 lanes; tram 1/11 and trolleybus 90 sections; poplar/linden rows on the embankments
research.frontage: N bank: Regie student campus (dormitories P1–P27, U1–U6: 5–9-storey 1970s blocks), Ibis Politehnica, Novum Invest office; S bank: UPB campus fence, Casa Corpului Didactic

top_local_details: The Dâmbovița is a straight concrete canal here with a one-way Splai on each bank.
Pasajul Basarab viaduct towers over Orhideelor — two levels, trams on it.
Podul Grozăvești is short; Grozăvești metro entrances at both ends.
Regie dorms: long rows of grey/cream 1970s student blocks on the north bank.
UPB Rectorat = white grid facade with red panels and a flat saucer dome on the roof, inside the fenced campus.
Bd. Doina Cornea has trams (1, 10, 11) in the median along the campus.
The Bridge glass towers (IBM, Bitdefender) on Orhideelor.
Lukoil station on Orhideelor (east side).
Students everywhere 08–20 in term time; kiosks, copy shops, cheap food.
Politehnica metro (M3) on Iuliu Maniu at the south edge; railway halt "Politehnica" on Doina Cornea.
Trolleybuses on Iuliu Maniu (61, 62, 63, 93).
New 11-storey offices on Iuliu Maniu (The Light One, Campus 6).
Poplars and lindens along the canal embankment.
Steel railings along the canal and on Podul Grozăvești.
No concrete barrier across Orhideelor at ground level.
Splai south bank is eastbound only, north bank westbound only.
Parking lots and parked cars filling campus roads.
Ibis Politehnica hotel by the Splai.
Fabrica Grivița / One Club bars at Regie.
Wide intersections with tram crossings at the bridge heads.
Cotroceni Palace area lies just south-east (outside).
Graffiti on canal walls and underpasses.
Bus 105 is the classic UPB–Regie line.
Evening queues on the Basarab ramps.
Open, flat, windy riverside — big sky.
Concrete lamp poles along the Splai, newer LED poles on Iuliu Maniu.
BCR branch in The Bridge.
Policlinica Regie and Sala de Sport Regie on Bd. Regiei.
Faculty buildings (Electronics/ETTI) at the south-east corner by the metro.
Dust and construction around new office projects on Iuliu Maniu.

driving.note: RO:urban default 50; several boulevards signed 60 (OSM maxspeed=60 on Lascăr Catargiu, Magheru, Dorobanți north).

markings.lane_line: white dashed 3 m line / 6 m gap on urban roads (RO standard SR 1848-7), 0.10–0.15 m wide
markings.centre_line: white continuous (single) on 2-lane two-way, double continuous on 4+ lane two-way without median
markings.zebra: white bars 0.5 m wide / 0.5 m gap, parallel to traffic, no side lines; a few school-zone crossings have red infill between the white bars (verify per crossing on refs)
markings.bus_lane: white continuous line with "BUS" text; since 2019 some STB lanes on Magheru axis/Ștefan cel Mare painted red-brown (#9E3B2E) – verify per street
markings.yellow: yellow only for temporary works and kerb no-parking (zig-zag at bus stops)
markings.wear: markings visibly worn/faded on most streets except freshly resurfaced arteries — use 60–80% opacity

kerbs.material: grey concrete kerbstones 15×25 cm (older streets: granite #8C8C8C), kerb height 12–18 cm, often chipped

sidewalks.paving: mix: (a) grey concrete interlocking pavers ("pavele") #A9A59C on renovated boulevards; (b) cracked asphalt #6E6C68 on side streets; (c) 40×40 grey concrete slabs on 1960–80s estates
sidewalks.parking_on_sidewalk: very common: cars half/fully on the sidewalk on side streets, behind metal bollards on boulevards

traffic_lights.model: RO 3-aspect vehicle heads (200/300 mm), black or yellow housing with yellow-black backplates on main arteries, mounted on grey/black poles + overhead mast arms at big junctions; pedestrian 2-aspect (red/green man) with countdown displays on major junctions

bus_shelter.style: STB/Clear-channel style glass shelters with grey steel frame and backlit ad panel; many stops have only a pole with the yellow STB stop sign + timetable

tram_track.style: standard gauge 1435 mm; on boulevards in a central reservation with concrete sleepers/ballast or grass, kerbed and fenced in places; overhead single contact wire on span wires

personas.name: Vlad (UPB student)
personas.desc: Computer-science student heading from Regie to the Politehnica campus.

greeting.en: Hey, which faculty are you at?

bumped.en: Hey, I have my laptop on me!

bumped.text: Scuze, eram cu ochii pe cod.
bumped.en: Sorry, I was looking at code.

photographed.en: For the year group chat? OK.
Make it quick, I have a lab.

idle.en: The canteen is full at one.
Shall we go to Fabrica after the exam?

district.text: De la Regie la Rectorat faci zece minute pe jos.
district.en: From Regie to the Rectorate is a ten-minute walk.

district.text: Splaiul e cu sens unic pe fiecare mal.
district.en: The Splai is one-way on each bank.

district.text: Metroul Grozăvești e chiar lângă pod.
district.en: Grozăvești metro is right by the bridge.

personas.name: Cristina (Regie dorm resident from Chișinău)
personas.desc: Engineering student from the Republic of Moldova living in the Regie dorms; same language, slightly different everyday words.

greeting.text: Bună ziua, știți unde-i căminul P5?
greeting.en: Good day, do you know where dorm P5 is?

photographed.en: I'll send the picture to my mum back home!
Take it with the Dâmbovița behind.

idle.text: Diseară gătim în bucătăria de la cămin.
idle.en: Tonight we cook in the dorm kitchen.

idle.text: De sărbători plec acasă cu autocarul.
idle.en: For the holidays I go home by coach.
Exams are on, I'm not going out.

district.text: Căminele din Regie sunt toate din anii șaptezeci.
district.en: The Regie dorms are all from the seventies.

district.text: Pe Splai bate vântul tot timpul.
district.en: The wind always blows on the Splai.

district.text: Biblioteca Politehnicii e deschisă până seara.
district.en: The Politehnica library is open until evening.

district.text: Pasajul Basarab se vede de la geamul meu.
district.en: I can see the Basarab overpass from my window.

personas.name: Prof. Ionescu (UPB lecturer)
personas.desc: Engineering professor in a tweed jacket, formal and dry-witted.

bumped.text: Mai încet, nu e examen de viteză.
bumped.en: Slower, this isn't a speed exam.

photographed.en: Photograph the building, it's more interesting.

idle.text: Am patruzeci de lucrări de corectat.
idle.en: I have forty papers to mark.

idle.text: Studenții de azi nu mai scriu de mână.
idle.en: Students today don't write by hand anymore.

idle.text: Ședința de consiliu e la două.
idle.en: The council meeting is at two.

district.text: Politehnica are rădăcini din 1818, școala lui Gheorghe Lazăr.
district.en: Politehnica's roots go back to 1818, Gheorghe Lazăr's school.
The Rectorate is at Splaiul Independenței 313.

district.text: Accesul cu mașina e doar cu permis, la barieră.
district.en: Car access is by permit only, at the barrier.

district.text: Pe vremuri veneam cu tramvaiul pe Splai.
district.en: In the old days I came by tram along the Splai.

personas.name: Bogdan (shaorma kiosk by the metro)
personas.desc: Runs a late-night shaorma window near Grozăvești metro.

greeting.en: Hi boss, what can I make you?

greeting.text: Bună seara, mai avem și falafel.
greeting.en: Good evening, we have falafel too.

bumped.en: Whoa, you nearly dropped the sauce!

photographed.text: Fă poză la shaorma, e vedeta!
photographed.en: Photograph the shaorma, it's the star!

photographed.text: Dă-ne și o stea pe hartă!
photographed.en: Give us a star on the map!

idle.text: La două noaptea vin toți studenții.
idle.en: At two a.m. all the students turn up.
We ran out of fries early today.

district.text: Lângă metrou e cea mai bună locație din Grozăvești.
district.en: Next to the metro is the best spot in Grozăvești.

district.text: Pe Orhideelor e trafic până seara târziu.
district.en: Orhideelor has traffic until late evening.

district.text: Studenții de la Regie sunt cei mai buni clienți.
district.en: The Regie students are the best customers.

district.text: Când plouă, se umple tot de umbrele aici.
district.en: When it rains, this place fills with umbrellas.

culture_notes.note: "Bună ziua" with strangers, "Salut/Neața" among young people; "dumneavoastră" (formal you) to older people; "Mersi" is as common as "Mulțumesc".
Bucharest drivers honk readily and often do not stop at zebras; pedestrians answer with sarcasm rather than aggression — keep lines teasing, not violent.
Cars parked on sidewalks are a constant pedestrian complaint; a natural topic for bumped/idle lines in side streets.
At OTP passengers order licensed taxis from touch-screen kiosks in Arrivals; unsolicited offers are a known nuisance — staff lines should point to the kiosks.
Personas are defined by role/place (student, vendor, commuter), never by ethnicity; Roma, Moldovan or diaspora characters are not caricatured; humour targets traffic, weather, parking and the metro.

Generic personas (local_elder, tour_guide …) and the pedestrian_general set (honked_at, near_miss, sidewalk_parking) live in bucharest-spots.json → dialogue_general; district personas below add place-specific lines.
